instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, and pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add vegan butter; cook, stirring occasionally, until bubbling and foamy, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add sage and garlic to the skillet with the butter. Stir constantly (off the heat), until sage and garlic are fragrant, about 1 minute. Set aside.

When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add half of the garlic-sage butter (reserving the rest for serving), milk, salt, and pepper; mash until smooth and creamy. (Alternatively, you can place these ingredients in the bowl of a stand mixer with a paddle attachment; mix on medium-low speed until smooth and creamy, 1-2 minutes.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup oat milk, original unsweetened
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer mashed potatoes to a serving dish. Drizzle with reserved garlic-sage butter and enjoy!
